mathematics: First lemma applies coarse total probability upper bound to b times each fine support probability and uses exact coarse tower identity for B; it needs no sign on b since no order multiplication by b occurs. Second lemma requires b nonnegative, keeps E and S joint, and treats positive good supported fibers by support probability=1. Unsupported or false-good fibers have zero joint numerator.
model_quantifiers: Support is an actual predicate on fine values, E is required to imply that support pointwise, S is constant on fine fibers, and hpoint is required only on positive good supported fine fibers. Coarse conditioning is explicitly positive. Both statements use actual PMF conditionalProbability, not a supplied conditional law.
adversarial_boundaries: Null fine fibers handled by finite total-probability theorem; unsupported fibers cannot leak target E due hE; false S cannot leak target E∧S due hS. B may have null coarse probability, giving exact zero joint contribution. No unjustified replacement of support weight by one.
